meta.name: sxo
meta.description: Search Experience Optimization (SXO), the bridge between SEO and UX/CRO. Audits the journey from the SERP click to the on-page goal: click-through factors (title, meta, rich results), then post-click signals that keep users and drive conversions: above-the-fold relevance and intent match, page speed / Core Web Vitals, readability, clear CTAs, mobile usability, and what causes pogo-sticking back to Google. Use when the user has decent rankings but poor CTR or poor on-page conversion, wants better dwell time / engagement, less bounce, or a page experience aligned with search intent. Trigger on: "SXO", "search experience optimization", "good rankings but low CTR", "high bounce rate from search", "pogo-sticking", "improve dwell time", "SEO and conversion", "ranking but not converting", "engagement signals", "make this page convert search traffic". For pure landing-page conversion in ads use /google-ads-landing; for content quality use /seo-page.

copy.tagline: 让有排名却没人点、留不住的页面提升点击与转化
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果关键词排名不错,但点击率和页面转化都很低
copy.tagline_en: Turn ranked pages into pages that earn clicks and convert visitors
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your pages rank well but get few clicks and few conversions

howto.what: 它会审核从搜索结果点击到页面目标的整条路径:先看标题、meta、富媒体摘要等点击因素,再看首屏意图匹配、Core Web Vitals、可读性、CTA 和移动端可用性。最后产出分成「SERP 点击」和「点击后」两半的 SXO 评分,以及按影响排序的修改项。
howto.when: 当你有排名但点击率或页面转化差、搜索流量跳出高、pogo-sticking,或想改善停留时间与参与度时触发。需要提供目标 URL、对应查询/意图和页面目标。

howto.what_en: Audits the path from search click to on-page goal: SERP title, meta and rich results, then above-the-fold intent match, Core Web Vitals, readability, CTAs and mobile usability. Produces an SXO score split into SERP-click and post-click halves, plus prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when rankings are decent but CTR or on-page conversion is poor, or for high search bounce, pogo-sticking or dwell-time goals. Needs a target URL, query/intent and page goal.
